hazard_sites_nepal.why: The 2026 event was a rock-ice avalanche off a hanging glacier, not a lake outburst. A lake-only inventory is the wrong prior for that event class.

places_region.why: Exposure ranking was computed against the Trishuli-basin-only place list, so every large earthquake pointed at the same valley.

hazard_sites_himalaya.why: The Nepal-box registry could not see Kedarnath (510 km outside) or Chamoli (449 km outside). Built by script so the extent is auditable and reproducible.
